subject: Re: Quick integration demo + GitHub permissions questions
content:
From: Samir Patel <samir@neonapps.io>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Subject: Interest in GitHub integration / demo request

Hi Tessa —

We signed up for Redwood last week and started poking around the integration docs. Our team (NeonApps) is particularly interested in GitHub + Actions support and whether Redwood can run inference without broad write permissions. Can we schedule a 30-minute demo next week? A couple of quick bullets of things we care about: 

- OAuth scopes required for repo-level vs org-level installs
- Support for Github Enterprise Server (GHE) behind firewall
- Example of CI/CD flow with Actions and caching (KV/prefix caching)

I attached a short integration spec (integration_spec.pdf) with our environment notes. Best times for us (PST): 11/23 afternoon or 11/24 morning.

Thanks —
Samir
Samir Patel
Lead Platform Engineer, NeonApps
https://neonapps.io

-----Original Message-----

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
To: Samir Patel <samir@neonapps.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Subject: Re: Interest in GitHub integration / demo request

Hi Samir —

Thanks for signing up and for the spec — this is super helpful. I'm Tessa on the SDR team; happy to get a demo on the calendar. 

We generally run a short 30-minute session that covers an integration overview + a quick technical deep-dive with one of our solutions engineers. Suggested slots (PST):
- Mon 11/23, 2:30–3:00pm
- Tue 11/24, 9:30–10:00am
- Tue 11/24, 11:00–11:30am

If none of those work, tell me a couple alternatives and we'll make it happen. Quick ask: could you confirm whether your GHE instance requires outbound proxies or an allowlist? That will help Karthik prepare.

Calendly link (if you prefer self-book): https://calendly.com/redwood-sdrs/30min

Looping in Marissa (AE) and Karthik (SE) to cover procurement/rollout and technical constraints.

Cheers,

Tessa Morgan
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
tessa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

On Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800, Samir Patel <samir@neonapps.io> wrote:
> Thanks Tessa — 2:30pm on 11/23 PST works for us.
> 
> A couple quick clarifications before the call: 
> - Our GHE is behind a corporate proxy; outbound is allowed but only on specific ports. We can provide IPs if needed.
> - We prefer org-install but would like to limit scopes; can Redwood integrate with repo-scoped installs and still preserve caching between runs?
>
> Also, here's our repo for the demo reference: https://github.com/neonapps/edge-agent

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
To: Samir Patel <samir@neonapps.io>, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Subject: Re: Interest in GitHub integration / demo request

Hi Samir —

Great to meet you (virtually). I'll be on the call to discuss rollout options, pricing signals for dedicated pools (if your CI will be heavy), and a suggested MVP pipeline. We'll keep the demo focused: 10 minutes product overview, 15 minutes technical Q&A with Karthik, 5 minutes next steps & action items.

I've attached a short initial MVP scope with constraints and a lightweight mutual action plan (redlined_mvp_requirements.docx) so we can align expectations before the meeting. If you have procurement timelines, drop them here and I'll prep the right materials.

Looking forward to it —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com


On Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:02:00 -0800 Samir Patel <samir@neonapps.io> wrote:
> Thanks Marissa — procurement is on a Q1 cycle but we want to validate the integration prior to scoping the budget. A quick ask: can Karthik show an example Action that uses only repo:status + metadata scopes (no write access)? That would be ideal for our security team.
> 
> Also, if it's useful, we can share a short set of test repos ahead of time.
> 
> —Samir

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
To: Samir Patel <samir@neonapps.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Subject: Confirmed: Redwood x NeonApps integration demo — Mon 11/23 2:30pm PST

Thanks again — slot confirmed and calendar invite sent (attached invite.ics). 

Agenda:
- 2:30–2:40pm: product overview & how Redwood maps to Actions-based workflows (Marissa)
- 2:40–2:55pm: technical deep-dive: OAuth scopes, GHE connectivity, caching patterns (Karthik)
- 2:55–3:00pm: next steps & mutual action plan (Tessa)

Pre-reads: integration_spec.pdf (Samir), redlined_mvp_requirements.docx (Marissa)

Karthik — per Samir we should prepare an example Action that demonstrates repo-scoped install with status/metadata-only scopes and show caching behavior across runs.

Samir — if you can share the test repo names (or grant a temporary read access) before the call that would speed things up.

See you Monday —

Tessa Morgan
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
tessa@redwood.com

Attachments: invite.ics (calendar invite), integration_spec.pdf (pdf), redlined_mvp_requirements.docx (docx)
